item: The keyword step's grouping of the incoming backup reads the table straight through instead of through the term index
refs: PR pending; user's restore report 2026-11-15 (91 s)
summary: rep_keywords (one incoming keyword per normalized_term and language, lowest id) let SQLite walk idx_keyword_normalized_term and fetch every row by rowid for its language, a random read over the largest table the merge copies. NOT INDEXED reads it in order and sorts: same groups, same MIN(id). Measured on 7M keyword rows, page cache dropped, memory held below the file size and reads throttled to 150 MB/s and 1,500 IOPS: 104.9 s to 20.0 s, the same 6,592,573 ids; fully cached 10.8 s to 8.9 s. The field run spent 91 s there. The low-memory scratch path already read the table in order and accepts the new statement shape. Links and source-relationship groupings are left as they were (not measured).
